# QTR-3 · Clarity review of the quarterly summary

*Reviewer · report/summary.md, checked against figures/q3-summary.md*

## Found (most important first)

1. **"because the board asked for a second round of changes"** — the figures say Northgate took eleven weeks, not
   why. This report goes to clients, Northgate Library among them: check with Jordan that we want to say this, or
   end the sentence at "took eleven".
2. **"The median project took five weeks"** — "median" may not be a word every client uses. "Half our projects took
   five weeks or less" says the same thing.
3. **"Every website this quarter was built as static pages"** — true, but a client may not know what that means.
   Say what it gave them: "cheaper to host, and nothing to keep updated".

## Passes

- 14 projects and 612 hours, and last quarter's 11 and 540, match the figures.
- 12 of 14 on the agreed date matches the figures.
- The quotes from the client interviews match Researcher's summary on RES-2.
- Length: 318 words, inside half a page.

The draft reads well. Item 1 should be settled before it goes out; 2 and 3 are Writer's call.
